name: low-angle-jeans-girl
image_purpose: Candid lifestyle post and casual home snapshot

prompt.project_info: Create an amateur low-angle smartphone snapshot from a relaxed floor-seated position at home.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with dark brown-to-black hair in a low ponytail, natural makeup, warm light-to-medium skin, thick dark brows, dark almond eyes, and a slight pout. She wears a white ribbed sleeveless cotton tank top and dark-blue jeans, sitting on the floor with knees comfortably drawn up and looking directly at the camera. A cat may appear overhead as in the reference.
prompt.composition_elements: Low-angle smartphone framing with the subject appearing smaller through perspective, knees in the foreground, smooth white ceiling and recessed light fixture above, and the cat near the top edge. Preserve natural floor-seated geometry and realistic denim folds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overhead indoor light with natural warmth on skin, realistic shadows beneath the knees and chin, spontaneous lived-in home atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Amateur low-angle smartphone snapshot, realistic wide-angle perspective, natural skin pores, individual hair strands, denim weave, subtle digital grain, no beauty smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An amateur low-angle smartphone snapshot of one approved adult woman with dark brown-to-black hair in a low ponytail, natural makeup, warm light-to-medium skin, thick dark brows, dark almond eyes, and a slight pout. She wears a white ribbed sleeveless cotton tank top and dark-blue jeans, sitting comfortably on the floor with knees drawn up and looking directly at the camera. Use an extreme perspective that makes her appear smaller in frame, with realistic denim folds, a smooth white ceiling, a recessed light fixture, and a cat near the top edge as shown in the reference. Soft overhead light, natural skin texture, fine hair detail, subtle grain, and authentic home-snapshot realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, unsafe animal interaction, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted perspective, extra limbs, deformed hands, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
